notes: PinballEscrow is the Space Pinball (NIGHTSHIFT) player-versus-player stake escrow. Its single constructor argument is the initial result signer, which the contract requires to equal the fixed owner 0x6c4c78f2c3bdf4c4318fe305fb1c8bc1694d19b5, so it is filled with $owner. The owner, both accepted tokens (IMD 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 and $SHIFT 0xe5e58e53d0bb204aa62c995a6c8cc8a48e60c3ac), the allowed stakes (IMD 1, 5, 10, 25; SHIFT 100000, 500000, 1000000, 5000000 whole tokens), the fixed 5% fee and the fee splitter 0x1119d5df2f046bc2d3c0f6279ef2e9ce49422d44 are compiled-in constants, not constructor inputs. The owner can only rotate the result signer (setSigner, emits SignerUpdated) and pause or unpause new opens; join, settle and refund keep working while paused. Results are EIP-712 typed data (domain SpacePinball, version 1, chain id 1, this contract; struct Result(bytes32 matchId, address winner, bool draw, uint256 deadline)). The constructor makes no external calls, so deployment works on an empty chain. No proxy, delegatecall or selfdestruct.
